meta.description: Tab Items let people switch to one view inside a Tab Group.

verdict.title: Keep — one icon slot and five settings
verdict.text: State, Orientation, Size, Placement and isSelected make 24 variants; hasIcon, hasCounter and hasNotificationDot switch the Icon Slot, a Counter instance and the red dot.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Used by Tabs across both orientations and two sizes. The Icon Slot and Counter make one atom cover icon tabs, label-only tabs, and tabs with a count.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own layout, border, and typography. The counter is a Counter instance on #EEF2F9 rather than a locally drawn pill with raw hex, so token changes propagate.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Five orthogonal props — State × Orientation × Size × Placement × isSelected. Booleans are lowercase true/false, matching the DS-wide standard, and State is kept separate from isSelected the way Radio Button models it. Placement is scoped to Horizontal by design, since Vertical stacks the icon above the label.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: A real Icon Slot SLOT (32px vertical / 24px horizontal) lets consumers swap in any icon, and the counter instances the canonical component so its updates propagate. Nests inside Tabs as an instance.

behavior.notes: Brand #005CE5 indicator border on the container, brand label.
Label beside the icon, 24px Icon Slot. Placement puts the icon leading or trailing.
Icon above the label, 32px Icon Slot. Only Placement=Leading ships.
Pill on #EEF2F9, radius 99999. A real instance, so Counter updates propagate.
6px #D61B2C notification dot. Modelled as a fixed layer by design rather than a boolean or slot.

Touch-down feedback — container stroke darkens to #2340A9, the DS pressed navy. Named Hover here; maps to the platform pressed binding (configuration.isPressed / InteractionSource) since touch has no hover. Ships at isSelected=true.
Non-interactive tab. Ships at isSelected=false — the current tab is not disabled in practice.

resolved.body: v2.0: Property isActive? renamed isSelected — the trailing ? is gone from the generated type. Values remain capitalised and are tracked separately. (C2)
v2.0: Icon placeholder replaced with a real Figma Icon Slot SLOT — 32 × 32 vertical, 24 × 24 horizontal, both empty and swappable. The hardcoded grey icon-placeholder circle is gone. (C6)
v2.0: Counter is now a Counter INSTANCE rather than a locally drawn pill, so updates to the canonical component propagate to every Tab Item. (C6)
v2.0: Counter colours moved off raw hex — the instance ships on #EEF2F9, matching the DS counter token, replacing the hardcoded #ECF1FA / #0F3390 pair. (C3)

v2.0: Leading-icon behaviour unified across orientations — both Vertical and Horizontal now carry the same Icon Slot, and icon position is expressed by the Placement property rather than a vertical-always-renders rule plus a hasLeadingIcon boolean. (C2)
v2.0: red-dot as a fixed 6px #D61B2C ELLIPSE confirmed intentional — kept as a layer rather than promoted to a boolean property or slot. (C6)

v2.1: isSelected values renamed True/False → true/false across all 12 variants — Tab Item is now on the DS-wide boolean standard alongside Radio Button, Select Item, and Select. Verified with no stray property values or conflicting variants. (C2)

v2.1: Interaction states added — a State axis (Default / Hover / Disabled) takes the set from 12 to 24 variants. State is kept orthogonal to isSelected rather than collapsed into it, because the two vary independently: isSelected is which tab is active, State is the transient interaction. Same model as Radio Button. (C5)

v2.1: State=Hover retained deliberately rather than renamed Pressed. The variants are painted #2340A9 (the DS pressed navy) and behave as the touch-down state; the term is a naming convention only. Tab Item is the sole component using Hover — Button, Radio Button, Select Item, and Select Group all say Pressed — so native code should bind it to the platform pressed state. (C2)

v2.1: State coverage confirmed intentional — Hover ships only at isSelected=true and Disabled only at isSelected=false, giving 24 of 36 theoretical cells. Reviewed and accepted as the useful set. (C5)
v2.1: Placement being meaningful only for Horizontal confirmed intentional — Vertical stacks the icon above the label, so a trailing (below-label) variant is not a layout GCash uses. (C2)

appliedRecommendations.headline: Rename isActive? → selected with true/false.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.1: Fully applied — the property is isSelected (trailing ? gone) and all 12 variants now carry lowercase true/false, matching Radio Button, Select Item, and Select. It maps straight to Bool.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Unify the leading-icon slot.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — both orientations carry the same Icon Slot, with icon position expressed by Placement instead of a vertical-only render plus a hasLeadingIcon boolean.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Replace the local counter pill with an instance.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — Counter is a real INSTANCE, so its updates propagate to every Tab Item.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Replace icon-placeholder with a swappable Icon slot.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — a real Figma Icon Slot SLOT ships in both orientations.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Add tokens for the counter.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — the counter instance ships on #EEF2F9, matching the DS counter token rather than raw hex.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Add pressed and disabled states.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.1: Applied — a State axis now ships (Default / Hover / Disabled), taking the set from 12 to 24 variants. State is orthogonal to isSelected, matching the Radio Button model rather than collapsing the two.

usageSnippets.swift: // Vertical tab with icon EBTabItem(label: "Overview", leading: Image("overview")) .selected(true) // Horizontal tab with counter EBTabItem(label: "Inbox", counter: 12) .orientation(.horizontal) .selected(false) // Horizontal tab with red-dot indicator EBTabItem(label: "Alerts", showBadge: true) .orientation(.horizontal)
usageSnippets.compose: // Vertical tab with icon EBTabItem( label = "Overview", leading = painterResource(R.drawable.overview), selected = true ) // Horizontal tab with counter EBTabItem( label = "Inbox", orientation = EBTabOrientation.Horizontal, counter = 12, selected = false ) // Horizontal tab with red-dot indicator EBTabItem( label = "Alerts", orientation = EBTabOrientation.Horizontal, showBadge = true )

usageGuidelines.doText: Use vertical orientation when tabs have icons + short labels (iconic nav). Use horizontal when labels are longer or icons aren't semantically needed.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Mix orientations within the same Tabs container.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use counter for numeric indicators (unread counts, items). Use showBadge for "new / unseen" indicators where the count is unimportant.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Stack counter + red-dot on the same tab — the counter already communicates "there's something here."

scorecard.notes: Semantic layers in every variant: container, icon-label, Icon Slot, label › #label, counter-container › Counter, red-dot.
isSelected true / false; State, Orientation, Size, Placement in Title Case; one Icon Slot property across all 24 variants.
Every label, underline, counter and dot is token-bound — text/color-text-primary(-hover), text/color-text-weaker, text/color-text-disabled, border/color-border-primary(-hover), bg/color-bg-strong.
Custom cell on iOS, Material Tab content on Android.
Default, Hover (the pressed state — kept by owner decision) and Disabled, each selected or not.
A real Icon Slot (32 vertical / 24 horizontal); the counter is a Counter instance.

rows.body: C1 Ready → Ready. Layer names re-read on node 26327:10941.
C2 Requires Rework → Ready. The old isActive? Yes/No is isSelected, and the second Icon Slot2 property on Disabled · Vertical · Large was removed in Figma.
C3 Requires Rework → Ready. The counter is a token-bound Counter instance, and the raw #2340A9 label on Hover · Vertical · Large is now bound to text/color-text-primary-hover.
C5 Requires Rework → Ready. Hover and Disabled are built.
C6 Requires Rework → Ready. The placeholder circle is a slot and the counter is an instance.
Keep · Ready. All four DS Health traits pass and C1–C6 are ready.

Resolved issues recorded. 11 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: v2.0: Property isActive? renamed isSelected — the trailing ? is gone from the generated type; v2.0: Icon placeholder replaced with a real Figma Icon Slot SLOT — 32 × 32 vertical, 24 × 24 horizontal, both empty and swappable; v2.0: Counter is now a Counter INSTANCE rather than a locally drawn pill, so updates to the canonical component propagate to every Tab Item; v2.0: Counter colours moved off raw hex — the instance ships on #EEF2F9, matching the DS counter token, replacing the hardcoded #ECF1FA / #0F3390 pair; v2.0: Leading-icon behaviour unified across orientations — both Vertical and Horizontal now carry the same Icon Slot, and icon position is expressed by the Placement property rather than a vertical-always-renders rule plus a hasLeadingIcon boolean; v2.0: red-dot as a fixed 6px #D61B2C ELLIPSE confirmed intentional — kept as a layer rather than promoted to a boolean property or slot; v2.1: isSelected values renamed True/False → true/false across all 12 variants — Tab Item is now on the DS-wide boolean standard alongside Radio Button, Select Item, and Select; v2.1: Interaction states added — a State axis (Default / Hover / Disabled) takes the set from 12 to 24 variants; v2.1: State=Hover retained deliberately rather than renamed Pressed; v2.1: State coverage confirmed intentional — Hover ships only at isSelected=true and Disabled only at isSelected=false, giving 24 of 36 theoretical cells; v2.1: Placement being meaningful only for Horizontal confirmed intentional — Vertical stacks the icon above the label, so a trailing (below-label) variant is not a layout GCash uses.
Component assessed — 8 variants across isActive × orientation × size. Horizontal variants expose optional leading icon, counter, and red-dot slots. Documented
Property naming issues — isActive? has a ? and uses Yes/No. Leading-icon slot behaves differently across orientations. Open
Counter colors hardcoded — #ECF1FA bg and #0F3390 label are raw hex. Should use tokens or instance the Badge component. Open
No pressed/disabled states — State coverage limited to active/inactive. Open
Icon placeholder + duplicated counter — Icon should be a swappable slot; counter should instance the canonical Badge. Open
Code Connect mappings — Not registered. Open
